Exam: mpMRI Prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 6.8 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 3+4. Evaluate for focal lesion.
FINDINGS: Prostate volume 36.0 mL. T2WI shows a focal area of low signal intensity in the left peripheral zone, mid-gland. DWI demonstrates restricted diffusion with high signal on b=1400 and corresponding ADC hypointensity. Dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE) sequence shows early focal enhancement in the same region. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion identified.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone, approximately 12 mm in diameter. Prostate volume 36.0 mL, PSA density 0.2 ng/mL/mL. Clinical T stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.82952833.
